panels.description: Alex tests the covered machine with his palm and inserts an old connector. Leave upper workshop space.
The cloth drops, revealing Bi11bot's rugged blue-and-mustard body, scarf and warm amber eyes. Leave upper space.
Alex studies Bi11bot while the robot faces him, non-menacing and slightly awkward. Leave upper space.
Bi11bot's shoulder projector warms over the workbench. Leave upper projection space.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Well. That took longer than expected.
